securityKey.title: Security key
securityKey.connectHint: Insert it, and unlock it if it asks; this window notices it by itself.
securityKey.helperFailed: Couldn't start the security key helper.
securityKey.keys: Tab moves · Enter activates · Alt+key on a button runs it · F5 refreshes · Esc closes
securityKey.touch: Touch the key when it blinks…
securityKey.fido.title: Sign in with the key
securityKey.fido.subtitle: FIDO2/U2F: sudo and polkit accept a touch of the key instead of your password.
securityKey.fido.none: No key registered for you yet.
securityKey.fido.pam.shared: sudo and polkit read keys from %1 (yours there: %2), not from your own list: an administrator has to switch pam_u2f to per-user lists before the keys registered here work there.
securityKey.fido.pam.missing: sudo and polkit don't ask for a security key yet: an administrator can turn that on with omarchy-setup-security-fido2.
securityKey.gpg.title: OpenPGP key on the card
securityKey.gpg.subtitle: Sign, decrypt and authenticate with gpg using the keys stored on the card.
securityKey.gpg.state.public: The public key is there, but not linked to the card yet.
securityKey.gpg.imported: Public key imported and linked to the card.
securityKey.gpg.importFailed: Couldn't find the public key at the card's URL or on the keyservers.
securityKey.gpg.trustedDone: The key is now ultimately trusted.
securityKey.gpg.removed: Removed from the keyring; the key stays on the card.
securityKey.gpg.secretOnDisk: gpg keeps a secret part of this key on disk, not only on the card: nothing was removed.
securityKey.ssh.title: Resident SSH keys
securityKey.ssh.subtitle: Copy the SSH keys kept on the security key into ~/.ssh, for instance on a new computer.
securityKey.ssh.none: The security key holds no SSH keys.
securityKey.ssh.touchNote: Each use of these keys still asks for a touch.
securityKey.error.pinBlocked: The PIN is blocked after too many wrong tries: unplug and reinsert the key, or reset it.
securityKey.error.timeout: The key wasn't touched in time.
